destination.title: Ultraviolet completion and consistency of gravity
destination.question: Which proposed gravitational frameworks and consistency tests address ultraviolet behavior, physical states and their low-energy consequences?
destination.summary: A broad proposed family covering competing constructions and diagnostics. General QFT methods, scalar models, computational tools and conjectural EFT restrictions provide bridges or alternate homes rather than evidence that a gravitational completion succeeds.

systems: Gravitational theories with different dimensions, derivative structures and matter content
General QFT and scalar or gauge models used as methodological comparisons
targets: Physical spectra, quantum unitarity, causality and stability
Classical backgrounds, cosmological consequences and EFT compatibility
regimes: Perturbative, nonperturbative and effective-theory questions remain separate
Euclidean, Lorentzian, flat-background and cosmological settings are source-specific
assumptions: Numerical membership is retrieval provenance, not scientific agreement
Competing completion mechanisms do not supply shared premises
conventions: Pole prescriptions, field normalizations and dimensional limits retain their source-specific meanings
includes: Alternate access to conjectural EFT and nongravitational questions
excludes: A universal resolution of the renormalizability–unitarity problem
Inference of full quantum consistency from an acceptable free spectrum
Identification of scalar-model results with demonstrated gravitational confinement

sources.title: Quantum Gravity at a Lifshitz Point

evidence.text: Can a self-contained quantum field theory of gravity in 3+1 dimensions improve ultraviolet behavior through anisotropic z=3 scaling, while relevant deformations produce relativistic scaling and potentially general relativity at long distances?

sources.title: Renormalizable 4D Quantum Gravity as A Perturbed Theory from CFT

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional quantum gravity be organized as a renormalizable perturbation of a CFT with an exactly treated conformal mode, and how do anomalies and renormalization affect the cosmological constant and Planck mass?

sources.title: Horava-Lifshitz gravity: a status report

evidence.text: Can gravity with higher spatial derivatives and only second-order time derivatives improve ultraviolet behaviour while remaining consistent and phenomenologically viable at low energies? This status report distinguishes the proposed versions and reviews their scalar dynamics, strong coupling, cosmology and unresolved issues.

sources.title: Renormalizable Quantum Gravity in Low Energy without Violating Unitarity

evidence.text: Can massive graviton ghost partners soften vacuum-energy and graviton-mass divergences at low energies while constraints on physical states preserve unitarity, and can this construction accommodate matter?

sources.title: Super-renormalizable Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can an infinite-derivative extension of quadratic gravity retain only the physical graviton pole, become perturbatively super-renormalizable, reproduce Einstein gravity in the infrared, and soften classical black-hole singularities?

sources.title: Unitarity versus Renormalizability of Higher Derivative Gravity in 3D

evidence.text: Can three-dimensional gravity with quadratic curvature terms be both perturbatively renormalizable and unitary around Minkowski space, especially at the new-massive-gravity coefficient choice? The paper also examines why an earlier renormalizability argument may fail.

sources.title: Super-renormalizable Higher-Derivative Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can an infinite-derivative extension of quadratic gravity improve ultraviolet behavior while avoiding additional negative-residue propagator poles and rendering the point-source gravitational potential regular?

sources.title: Do we have unitary and (super)renormalizable quantum gravity below the Planck scale?

evidence.text: Does the presence of massive higher-derivative ghosts necessarily destabilise low-energy gravitational backgrounds, or does runaway behaviour depend on the initial perturbation frequency and background curvature scale?

sources.title: Multidimensional finite quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can a nonpolynomial higher-derivative completion of Einstein gravity retain the physical graviton spectrum, make higher-loop amplitudes convergent in arbitrary dimension, and eliminate the remaining one-loop divergences through covariant Pauli–Villars conditions?

sources.title: Super-renormalizable or finite Lee–Wick quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can local gravity with finitely many higher derivatives combine Einstein behavior at low energy, perturbative super-renormalizability or finiteness, and Lee–Wick unitarity by allowing complex-conjugate poles while excluding additional real propagator poles?

sources.title: Consistent higher derivative gravitational theories with stable de Sitter and anti–de Sitter backgrounds

evidence.text: Which conditions on generally covariant higher-derivative metric actions ensure dS or AdS backgrounds with no ghost-like or tachyonic states in the perturbative spectrum, including actions with infinitely many derivatives?

sources.title: Hořava gravity at a Lifshitz point: A progress report

evidence.text: Can anisotropic gravity improve ultraviolet behavior while avoiding ghosts and satisfying low-energy observations? This review assesses four versions, universal-horizon physics, nonrelativistic holography and progress toward quantization.

sources.title: On the quantum field theory of the gravitational interactions

evidence.text: Can a local higher-derivative quantum field theory of gravity reconcile perturbative unitarity with renormalizability, and can a dimensionless gravitational gauge coupling select a unique model within this framework?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity, Fakeons And Microcausality

evidence.text: What do the one-loop absorptive self-energies and widths of the graviton multiplet imply about fakeon quantization, perturbative unitarity, and microcausality, and how do these results change when the spin-2 mode is quantized as a Stelle ghost?

sources.title: Recent Progress in Fighting Ghosts in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Under what conditions can higher-derivative quantum gravity reconcile renormalizability with unitarity and classical stability despite massive ghost states? The review emphasizes complex-pole Lee-Wick constructions and cosmological perturbation stability.

sources.title: Conformal Symmetry in Field Theory and in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can higher-derivative or weakly nonlocal gravity achieve UV finiteness, unitarity and non-anomalous local conformal symmetry, and what further constraints does conformality impose on effective actions and scattering?

sources.title: Exorcising ghosts in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can ghosts in finite higher-derivative gravity be interpreted as truncation artifacts and excluded through boundary conditions while retaining the ultraviolet behavior responsible for renormalizability?

sources.title: Unattainability of the trans-Planckian regime in nonlocal quantum gravity

evidence.text: Does ultraviolet asymptotic freedom in generalized nonlocal quantum gravity prevent accelerator access to trans-Planckian energies, hide microscopic causality violations, and suppress trans-Planckian corrections to inflationary perturbations?

sources.title: Reconstructing the graviton

evidence.text: What Lorentzian spectral information can be reconstructed from Euclidean fluctuation and background graviton propagators in asymptotically safe gravity, and what can their different signs and normalizations imply about unitarity?

sources.title: Finite action principle and Hořava-Lifshitz gravity: Early universe, black holes, and wormholes

evidence.text: Assuming the Finite Action Principle, which early-universe, black-hole and wormhole geometries have finite ultraviolet action in Hořava–Lifshitz gravity, and can this provide a selection mechanism for cosmological initial conditions and singularity avoidance?

sources.title: Composite higher derivative operators in <math display="inline"><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>ε</mi></mrow></math> dimensions and the spectrum of asymptotically safe gravity

evidence.text: Can perturbative gravity near two dimensions yield a physical, gauge- and parametrization-independent spectrum of curvature-squared composite operators, and what does its extrapolation suggest about relevant directions in four-dimensional asymptotic safety?

sources.title: Higher-derivative quantum gravity with purely virtual particles: renormalizability and unitarity

evidence.text: Can the massive spin-2 ghost required by renormalizable higher-derivative gravity be excluded from on-shell states while retaining its virtual contributions, thereby reconciling perturbative renormalizability and unitarity? The review also asks how this prescription affects inflationary observables.

sources.title: Strict renormalizability as a paradigm for fundamental physics

evidence.text: Can strict perturbative renormalizability select a predictive gravitational QFT extending GR, with observational support already below the Planck scale?

sources.title: Perturbative unitarity of fractional field theories and gravity

evidence.text: Can fractional scalar, gauge and gravitational QFTs have perturbative unitarity compatible with ultraviolet renormalizability, and how do kinetic-operator definitions, Riemann-sheet choices and fakeon prescriptions affect their spectra and causality?

sources.title: Self-Gravitation of Mode Quanta in a Causal Resonator: One-Loop Finiteness in Linearized Quantum Gravity and the Emergence of the Dark-Energy Scale

evidence.text: Can causal restrictions and mode self-gravitation supply a physical ultraviolet suppression for gravitational loops and a coherent vacuum density near the dark-energy scale?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity at a Lifshitz Point

evidence.text: ADM-like extrinsic curvature Kij=(ġij−∇iNj−∇jNi)/(2N) supplies the kinetic term. Weighted power counting gives [κ]=(z−D)/2, making κ dimensionless at D=z=3.

sources.title: Renormalizable 4D Quantum Gravity as A Perturbed Theory from CFT

evidence.text: BRST gauge fixing is implemented in Feynman gauge. A fictitious mass regulates gravitational infrared divergences by replacing 1/k⁴ with 1/(k²+z²)², followed by cancellation checks and z→0.

sources.title: Horava-Lifshitz gravity: a status report

evidence.text: Uses anisotropic engineering dimensions [dt] = [κ]^-z and [dx] = [κ]^-1 to count coupling dimensions. The scalar example has [φ] = [κ]^((d−z)/2); the gravitational discussion additionally accounts for spatial derivatives in self-interaction vertices.

sources.title: Renormalizable Quantum Gravity in Low Energy without Violating Unitarity

evidence.text: Canonical quantization of gravitational waves in transverse-traceless gauge, followed by physical-state constraints involving positive-frequency field combinations and relations between Gaussian wave packets.

sources.title: Super-renormalizable Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Spectral dimension is extracted from heat-kernel return probabilities. Black-hole profiles use Fourier smearing of the source, numerical density integrals, and integration of the resulting mass function.

sources.title: Unitarity versus Renormalizability of Higher Derivative Gravity in 3D

evidence.text: Power counts arbitrary 1PI diagrams using k^−4 graviton propagators, k^−2 ghost propagators and two-/four-derivative gravitational vertices. In Landau gauge, each external ghost or antighost contributes two external momenta, strengthening the convergence bounds.

sources.title: Positivity of Curvature-Squared Corrections in Gravity

evidence.text: What sign constraint does unitarity impose on the leading Gauss–Bonnet curvature-squared coefficient in pure gravity, when that operator is generated by a healthy tree-level ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity Constraints from Unitarity and Analyticity

evidence.text: Which quadratic and quartic curvature corrections to Einstein gravity are compatible with unitarity and analyticity of four-graviton scattering in a perturbative ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: Triviality of higher derivative theories

evidence.text: Can certain higher-derivative theories admit a BRST symmetry arising from their derivative structure, allowing a cohomological physical-state prescription to remove negative-norm states, and what spectrum and S-matrix then remain?

sources.title: A Pedagogical explanation for the non-renormalizability of gravity

evidence.text: Why should gravity fail to admit a renormalizable local quantum-field-theory completion in the same spacetime dimension, using high-energy density of states rather than only perturbative irrelevance of Newton's coupling?

sources.title: Causality Constrains Higher Curvature Corrections to Gravity

evidence.text: Which signs of four-dimensional quartic Riemann corrections avoid positive ultraviolet graviton group-velocity shifts, and do quadratic or cubic curvature corrections modify propagation in the same approximation?

sources.title: Bound states of massive complex ghosts in superrenormalizable quantum gravity theories

evidence.text: Can complex-conjugate massive ghost-like excitations form a normal composite with real mass and positive pole residue, providing a possible route toward stability in superrenormalizable gravity? The actual bound-state calculation uses a scalar toy model.

sources.title: Positive Signs in Massive Gravity

evidence.text: What restrictions do unitary, analytic graviton scattering amplitudes impose on ghost-free massive gravity, and can the full massive-spin-2 theory avoid the forward-positivity obstruction of its isolated Galileon limit?

sources.title: Causality, unitarity and stability in quantum gravity: a non-perturbative perspective

evidence.text: Which momentum dependence and singularity structures allow a dressed graviton propagator to satisfy non-perturbative unitarity, causality and stability while admitting analytic Wick rotation?

sources.title: Finiteness of quantum gravity coupled with matter in three space-time dimensions

evidence.text: Can three-dimensional quantum gravity coupled to interacting conformal matter be made finite by fixing irrelevant couplings, while retaining the Newton constant and matter marginal couplings as independent parameters?

sources.title: Self-Completeness of Einstein Gravity

evidence.text: Can pure Einstein gravity complete its own deep-UV physics through black-hole formation, without additional trans-Planckian propagating quantum fields or a Wilsonian UV fixed point?

sources.title: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity in Four-Dimensional Spacetime

evidence.text: Can rescaling the higher-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet coupling by 1/(D−4), followed by a continuous D→4 limit, define modified four-dimensional gravity while retaining covariance, second-order dynamics, and only massless graviton polarizations?

sources.title: The Phantom menaced: Constraints on low-energy effective ghosts

evidence.text: How low must the ultraviolet cutoff of a scalar ghost effective theory be to suppress observable vacuum instability, and can a Lorentz-invariant cutoff suffice?

sources.title: Renormalizability of Massive Gravity in Three Dimensions

evidence.text: Can three-dimensional new massive gravity be shown perturbatively renormalizable while preserving the special higher-derivative structure underlying its previously claimed unitary massive spin-2 spectrum?

sources.title: Ghost-free infinite derivative gravity

evidence.text: Can the four-derivative gravitational action containing R²/3 − RμνRμν receive a classically ghost-free completion through infinitely many higher derivatives, with a physical interpretation supplied by bimetric gravity?

sources.title: Swampland conditions for higher derivative couplings from CFT

evidence.text: What dimension-dependent spectral factor enters the gravitational correction to the four-derivative scalar coupling bound?

sources.title: Projectable Horava-Lifshitz gravity in a nutshell

evidence.text: Review how anisotropic spatial derivatives motivate Hořava–Lifshitz gravity and assess the viability of its projectable version, particularly its additional scalar degree of freedom.

sources.title: FeynGrav 3.0

evidence.text: How can recursive geometric expansions improve FeynGrav’s generation of perturbative gravitational Feynman rules, and how can its supported models be extended to Horndeski, scalar–Gauss–Bonnet, axion-like, massive-spin-2, and quadratic-gravity sectors?

sources.title: Nonperturbative evolution equation for quantum gravity

evidence.text: How can a diffeomorphism-invariant gravitational effective action at infrared scale k obey an exact nonperturbative renormalization-group equation, and what does an Einstein–Hilbert truncation predict for running Newton and cosmological constants in 2+ε and four dimensions?

sources.title: Reflection positivity in a higher-derivative model with physical bound states of ghosts

evidence.text: Does the composite bound-state operator in a previously proposed six-derivative scalar ghost model satisfy two-point Osterwalder–Schrader reflection positivity and admit a renormalized Källén–Lehmann representation with nonnegative spectral density?

sources.title: Renormalization of Higher Derivative Quantum Gravity Coupled to a Scalar with Shift Symmetry

evidence.text: Does gravity coupled to a shift-symmetric scalar remain perturbatively renormalizable when both kinetic terms and interactions contain up to four derivatives, and how does the answer depend on D = 3, 4 or 5?

sources.title: Unitary Issues in Some Higher Derivative Field Theories

evidence.text: Does eliminating ghost poles and improving ultraviolet behavior suffice for a higher-derivative theory to define a unitary fundamental quantum field theory? The paper tests this using Euclidean reflection positivity and spectral representations.

sources.title: Fakeons And Lee-Wick Models

evidence.text: Can theories containing physical particles and fakeons, including Lee-Wick higher-derivative theories, admit a consistent prescription that preserves perturbative unitarity to all orders and inherits Euclidean renormalization?

sources.title: Light fermions in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can quantum metric fluctuations induce chiral symmetry breaking and Planck-scale fermion masses, and what restrictions does the existence of light fermions place on asymptotically safe or effective quantum gravity?

sources.title: Asymptotic safety of gravity-matter systems

evidence.text: Do minimally coupled scalars and fermions preserve an attractive gravitational UV fixed point when Newton's coupling is extracted from dynamical correlation functions, and what matter-content conclusions survive regulator validity bounds?

sources.title: Upper bound on the Abelian gauge coupling from asymptotic safety

evidence.text: Can asymptotically safe gravity ultraviolet-complete an Abelian gauge theory and impose an upper bound, or a unique prediction, for the infrared gauge coupling?

sources.title: Investigating the Ultraviolet Properties of Gravity with a Wilsonian Renormalization Group Equation

evidence.text: Does gravitational RG flow admit a non-Gaussian ultraviolet fixed point with finitely many attractive directions, and how robust is the evidence under changes of cutoff scheme and truncation?

sources.title: Renormalizability of Massive Gravity in Three Dimensions

evidence.text: Can three-dimensional new massive gravity be shown perturbatively renormalizable while preserving the special higher-derivative structure underlying its previously claimed unitary massive spin-2 spectrum?

sources.title: QED coupled to QEG

evidence.text: Can QED coupled to asymptotically safe Quantum Einstein Gravity possess an interacting continuum limit, avoid its Landau singularity, and predict the infrared electric charge rather than require it as an independent input?

sources.title: Renormalization of Higher Derivative Quantum Gravity Coupled to a Scalar with Shift Symmetry

evidence.text: Does gravity coupled to a shift-symmetric scalar remain perturbatively renormalizable when both kinetic terms and interactions contain up to four derivatives, and how does the answer depend on D = 3, 4 or 5?

sources.title: Consistency of matter models with asymptotically safe quantum gravity

evidence.text: Which matter spectra admit a viable asymptotically safe gravitational fixed point within the studied truncations, and could particle searches provide consistency tests of this quantum-gravity scenario?

sources.title: Further evidence for asymptotic safety of quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can an interacting ultraviolet fixed point of four-dimensional gravity be identified self-consistently as higher-curvature operators are added, and does canonical mass dimension remain a useful guide to operator relevance?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity Constraints from Unitarity and Analyticity

evidence.text: Which quadratic and quartic curvature corrections to Einstein gravity are compatible with unitarity and analyticity of four-graviton scattering in a perturbative ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: The unitary conformal field theory behind 2D Asymptotic Safety

evidence.text: Can the Einstein–Hilbert truncation underlying Asymptotic Safety yield an intrinsically two-dimensional fixed-point theory compatible with Hilbert space positivity, and what are its central charge and gravitational dressing?

sources.title: Positivity of Curvature-Squared Corrections in Gravity

evidence.text: What sign constraint does unitarity impose on the leading Gauss–Bonnet curvature-squared coefficient in pure gravity, when that operator is generated by a healthy tree-level ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: Asymptotically safe cosmology – A status report

evidence.text: How can gravitational asymptotic safety connect ultraviolet fixed-point behavior to classical cosmology, inflation, primordial fluctuations and the initial singularity, and how far can resulting effective models be confronted with observations?

sources.title: Asymptotic safety of higher derivative quantum gravity non-minimally coupled with a matter system

evidence.text: Do four-derivative gravity and its non-minimal coupling to a Higgs–Yukawa toy model admit non-trivial UV fixed points, and which relevant directions survive changes of truncation and gauge parameters?

sources.title: Viability of quantum-gravity induced ultraviolet completions for matter

evidence.text: Can the existence of interacting matter with viable electroweak properties constrain microscopic asymptotically safe gravity through real matter fixed points and RG trajectories accommodating finite fermion masses?

sources.title: Fakeons And Lee-Wick Models

evidence.text: Can theories containing physical particles and fakeons, including Lee-Wick higher-derivative theories, admit a consistent prescription that preserves perturbative unitarity to all orders and inherits Euclidean renormalization?

sources.title: Unitary Issues in Some Higher Derivative Field Theories

evidence.text: Does eliminating ghost poles and improving ultraviolet behavior suffice for a higher-derivative theory to define a unitary fundamental quantum field theory? The paper tests this using Euclidean reflection positivity and spectral representations.

sources.title: Ghost-free infinite derivative gravity

evidence.text: Can the four-derivative gravitational action containing R²/3 − RμνRμν receive a classically ghost-free completion through infinitely many higher derivatives, with a physical interpretation supplied by bimetric gravity?

sources.title: Aspects of asymptotic safety for quantum gravity

evidence.text: Does removing regulator-induced curvature poles change interacting gravitational fixed points, their relevant directions, near-Gaussian higher-order scaling, or constant-curvature vacuum solutions?

sources.title: Scales and hierachies in asymptotically safe quantum gravity: a review

evidence.text: How can asymptotically safe gravity accommodate the observed cosmological constant and its hierarchy with the Planck scale, retain predictive power, and determine remaining gravitational couplings from cosmology?

sources.title: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity in Four-Dimensional Spacetime

evidence.text: Can rescaling the higher-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet coupling by 1/(D−4), followed by a continuous D→4 limit, define modified four-dimensional gravity while retaining covariance, second-order dynamics, and only massless graviton polarizations?

sources.title: Critical reflections on asymptotically safe gravity

evidence.text: What supports asymptotically safe gravity, which conceptual and technical obstacles remain, and how can fixed-point studies progress toward controlled calculations of observables?

sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: Can asymptotically safe gravity restrict interactions between a visible scalar sector and a scalar or Yukawa dark sector?

sources.title: Constraining power of asymptotic safety for scalar fields

evidence.text: How sensitive are scalar-gravity fixed points and their relevant directions to regulator dependence and anomalous-dimension prescriptions? The appendix distinguishes scalar, metric-fluctuation, and background Newton-coupling anomalous dimensions.

sources.title: Light charged fermions in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can gravity support an interacting Abelian ultraviolet fixed point without making charged fermions critical, and does compatibility with light fermions impose a lower bound on their number?

sources.title: Cosmological α′-corrections from the functional renormalization group

evidence.text: Can T-duality constraints and functional renormalization group methods determine cosmological α′ corrections to all orders, with a suitable ultraviolet fixed point and an Einstein-like infrared limit?

sources.title: Swampland conditions for higher derivative couplings from CFT

evidence.text: What dimension-dependent spectral factor enters the gravitational correction to the four-derivative scalar coupling bound?

sources.title: Characters, quasinormal modes, and Schwinger pairs in dS$_{2}$ with flux

evidence.text: Does integrating the coincident scalar Green function over mass squared reproduce the imaginary part of the scalar one-loop partition function? Appendix B targets the imaginary component of a consistency relation introduced on omitted pages.

sources.title: Are there ALPs in the asymptotically safe landscape?

evidence.text: Can fundamental pseudoscalar ALPs with nonzero mass and photon coupling admit an asymptotically safe gravity-matter UV completion, and does this requirement constrain their low-energy parameter space?

sources.title: Causality, unitarity and stability in quantum gravity: a non-perturbative perspective

evidence.text: Which momentum dependence and singularity structures allow a dressed graviton propagator to satisfy non-perturbative unitarity, causality and stability while admitting analytic Wick rotation?

sources.title: Investigating the Ultraviolet Properties of Gravity with a Wilsonian Renormalization Group Equation

evidence.text: For Δ=−∇²+E1+E2, cutoff types I, II and III use −∇², −∇²+E1 and full Δ respectively; E2 contains couplings. Type III is spectrally adjusted. Most explicit calculations use an optimized profile.

sources.title: Renormalizability of Massive Gravity in Three Dimensions

evidence.text: Counts derivatives and internal lines in 1PI diagrams, improves ghost counting using the asserted graviton transversality, and combines the divergence bound with a linearized Slavnov-Taylor renormalization equation to classify local counterterms.

sources.title: QED coupled to QEG

evidence.text: Find common beta-function zeros and linearize the flow. A block-triangular stability matrix retains the two pure-gravity eigenvalues; the third eigenvalue determines whether α adds a free parameter to the UV critical surface.

sources.title: Light fermions in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Project the Wetterich functional RG equation for the effective average action onto the retained operators. Its supertrace incorporates full regulated propagators and vertices, with a negative contribution for Grassmann fields.

sources.title: Renormalization of Higher Derivative Quantum Gravity Coupled to a Scalar with Shift Symmetry

evidence.text: Spin-projector decomposition and inversion of the gauge-fixed quadratic action produce graviton and scalar propagators. In Landau gauge these are stated to fall as k⁻⁴, while the Faddeev-Popov ghost propagator falls as k⁻².

sources.title: Consistency of matter models with asymptotically safe quantum gravity

evidence.text: The gravitino calculation uses an irreducible SO(5) decomposition on a four-dimensional spherical background and local-supersymmetry gauge fixing with alpha'=0. Faddeev-Popov and Nielsen-Kallosh ghosts reduce the stated eight components to two propagating degrees of freedom.

sources.title: Covariant methods for the calculation of the effective action in quantum field theory and investigation of higher derivative quantum gravity

evidence.text: How can effective actions and their nonlocal structure be calculated manifestly covariantly, and what do one-loop divergences imply for the ultraviolet behavior and background stability of curvature-squared quantum gravity?

sources.title: Recent Progress in Fighting Ghosts in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Under what conditions can higher-derivative quantum gravity reconcile renormalizability with unitarity and classical stability despite massive ghost states? The review emphasizes complex-pole Lee-Wick constructions and cosmological perturbation stability.
